svg.title: CWB feature recommendation — what to build, what to specify, what to cut
svg.desc: Three-tier map organizing all research features into: Build (ship for demo), Specify (design in thesis, no code), and Cut (out of scope for a 2-person project).
svg.text: A. Core smart contracts — 4-tier banking hierarchy
Specify in thesis — no code needed, full academic credit
Cut entirely — mention as related work only
